rationale: Henry Hub (NG=F) is the hypothesised driver; the intended response is the PUDL EIA-923 monthly gas fuel-cost-at-plant series, which does not appear in the visible (truncated) catalogue, so TTF=F.close is the closest available delivered-gas price proxy - pct_change with up to 30-day lag captures monthly contract pass-through, and compare_pre_post tests whether the Henry Hub linkage weakened after the war began (caveat: TTF is not US plant fuel cost, and both series share the war as a common driver).
